title: Create the V4 architecture decision set and roadmap
goal: Record the cancelled Plan 08 alternative and define the reviewed architecture, staged implementation plan and deferred backlog for a new self-contained V4 guard plugin without changing the active V3/V3_ifx runtime.
acceptanceCriteria: Plan 08 is explicitly cancelled and P06-PCF-01 remains open for disposition by the future V4 program.
V4 planning documents live under docs/guards/v4/plans and distinguish accepted v1 decisions from explicitly deferred roadmap decisions.
The accepted runtime boundary defines a .NET CLI host, controlled PowerShell/.NET adapters, four explicit roots, module capabilities, target mutation receipts and base-owned CI verdicts.

V4 genesis uses V3 only for the formal bootstrap Plan, exact additive diff, current-guard non-interference, isolation and recovery; after an accepted seed establishes the development base, V4-only changes use base-owned V4 checks without a V3 runtime or IFX product-suite dependency.
Architecture Conformance is planned as a V4-owned composite over Project Model, Roslyn and ArchUnitNET evidence with claim-based parity and no V3/LayerGuard runtime dependency.
The V4 roadmap provides stable unchecked checklist IDs for every Phase item and gate, and the V4 runtime architecture document diagrams root, detector, Stage and CI trust boundaries.
The V4 v1 plan covers only the generic plugin, default and synthetic profiles, independent local stages, safe state/reset, Linux-first CI and plan-set support.
IFX profile practice, Web UI, fully bundled runtimes, standalone repository extraction, remote activation and V3/V3_ifx retirement are recorded in the V4 TODO with revisit gates.
No branch, workflow, ruleset, implementation, profile, trusted component, policy, authorization record or remote configuration changes in this planning checkpoint.
